title: Teenieping OC Ideas: 40 Names, Themes, Powers and OC x Canon Prompts (2026)
summary: 40 original Teenieping OC ideas by team, from Emotion to Season 7 Stage Teeniepings, with -ping name ideas, powers, personalities and OC x canon prompts.
body_markdown:
**Quick answer:** The easiest way to come up with a Teenieping OC is to copy the show’s own formula: pick **one feeling or theme** , turn it into a name ending in **“-ping”** , give it a color palette and one signature accessory, and decide how its magic spreads that feeling to people. Below you’ll find **40 original Teenieping OC ideas** sorted by the teams from each season of *Catch! Teenieping* , plus name tips, personality ideas and OC x canon story prompts with Romi, Heartsping and the Season 7 Royal Teeniepings.


Every OC name on this list was checked against the fan wiki’s Teenieping lists in November 2026, so none of them is an existing canon Teenieping. They’re free to use as a starting point for your own character.


Table of Contents


Toggle


##


How Teeniepings Work (So Your OC Fits the Show)


#


According to the[official SAMG show page](https://www.samg.net/en/content/4) , Teeniepings are magical fairies that represent emotions and feelings. In Season 1, Princess Romi of the Emotion Kingdom accidentally frees these “mind fairies,” which can affect people’s emotions and behavior, and has to catch them all on Earth. Every season since then has followed the same pattern, which is great news for OC makers:


- **One Teenieping, one idea.** Each official Teenieping stands for a single feeling or trait. The Season 7 team on SAMG’s site is a good example: Lemonping is the Teenieping of Spotlight, Cherryping is the Teenieping of Diligence and Limeping is the Teenieping of Beat.
- **Themed teams by season.** The show moves from Jewel Teeniepings in Season 2 to Key Teeniepings in Season 3, Dessert Teeniepings in Season 4, Star Teeniepings in Season 5, Princess Teeniepings in Season 6 and Stage Teeniepings in Season 7.
- **Royal Teeniepings help Romi.** Heartsping, the Teenieping of Love, stays by Romi’s side, and a new team of Royal Teeniepings joins them each season.
- **Props and magic.** In Season 2, SAMG lists a jewel, a prop and a magic move for each Royal Teenieping: Heartsping has a pink diamond, a harp and “Lovely Tune,” while Trustping, the Teenieping of Trust, has a sapphire, an umbrella and “Faithful Shield.”


So a strong Teenieping OC needs four things: a **theme** , a **-ping name** , a **look** that shows the theme at a glance, and a **power** . Each idea below gives you all four. Want a refresher on the canon cast first? See our[Teenieping characters list](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/teenieping-characters) .


© SAMG


##


40 Teenieping OC Ideas by Team


#


Pick a team that matches the season you love most, then change anything you like. Colors and accessories are suggestions, not rules.


###


Emotion Teenieping OC Ideas (Season 1 Style)


#


The original Teeniepings are pure feelings, which makes them the easiest OCs to start with. They work great as mischievous Teeniepings Romi has to catch.


OC name Theme Look Power idea


Blushping Embarrassment Rosy pink fur, cheek swirls, a scarf it hides behind Makes everyone nearby blush and stumble over their words


Braveping Courage Orange and gold, a tiny cape and a shield-shaped tail Gives a shy friend one burst of courage at the right moment


Grumbleping Grumpiness Stormy gray-blue, a little rain cloud above its head Its cloud rains on anyone it decides is “too cheerful”


Hugping Comfort Soft cream fur, extra-long fluffy arms, a heart pocket A warm hug that calms any meltdown


Proudping Pride Purple with a gold crown-shaped fringe and a medal Makes people show off, which can be sweet or a disaster


###


Jewel Teenieping OC Ideas (Season 2 Style)


#


In *Twinkle Catch! Teenieping* , the Jewel Teeniepings come from the Jewel Forest, and each Royal Teenieping has its own gem. Give your OC a gem that matches its personality.


OC name Theme Look Power idea


Opalping Curiosity Shifting rainbow-white fur and opal earrings Its gem changes color to point toward a secret


Amberping Patience Honey-orange fur with an amber pendant Freezes a moment in time so a friend can think before acting


Topazping Confidence Golden yellow, a topaz star on its forehead Turns a nervous speech into a perfect performance


Pearlping Gentleness Pearl-white with lilac tips and a pearl necklace A soft glow that ends arguments


Moonstoneping Dreams Silver-blue with a moonstone hairclip Shows people a glimpse of what they wish for in their sleep


###


Key Teenieping OC Ideas (Season 3 Style)


#


*Secret Catch! Teenieping* brings Key Teeniepings to Harmony Town, plus a mysterious secret Teenieping. These OCs are perfect for mystery plots.


OC name Theme Look Power idea


Riddleping Puzzles Teal with question-mark curls and a riddle scroll Only lets you pass if you solve its riddle


Diaryping Secrets Lavender with a tiny locked diary and a key tail Makes people spill a secret, then hides it again


Lockping Caution Bronze with a padlock badge and key earrings Locks doors, drawers and sometimes mouths


Clueping Detective Brown and beige, a magnifying glass and a cap Leaves glowing footprints that lead to the truth


Compassping Adventure Green with a compass belly emblem and a map cape Turns any street into a treasure hunt


###


Dessert Teenieping OC Ideas (Season 4 Style)


#


*Dessert Catch! Teenieping* fills Harmony Town with sweet-themed Teeniepings, and dessert OCs are a fan favorite because they’re fun to design.


OC name Theme Look Power idea


Mochiping Softness Round, squishy pastel pink and green, a mochi on its head Makes anyone it hugs feel relaxed and sleepy


Bobaping Bubbly fun Milky-tea brown with dark pearl dots and a straw antenna Fills a room with bouncing boba bubbles


Tartping Sharp honesty Berry red with a pastry-crust skirt Makes people say exactly what they think, sweet or sour


Churroping Energy Golden with cinnamon-sugar sparkles and a spiral tail A sugar rush that makes everyone dance


Sorbetping Cool calm Icy pastel layers with a scoop-shaped fringe Cools down hot tempers instantly


###


Star Teenieping OC Ideas (Season 5 Style)


#


In *Star Catch! Teenieping* , the Royal Teeniepings include Shimmerping (healing), Sparkleping (wishes) and Twinkleping (joy). Space themes are a natural fit.


OC name Theme Look Power idea


Cometping Speed Bright blue with a glowing star-trail tail Leaves a streak of light that grants one fast wish


Moonping Quiet kindness Pale silver with a crescent-moon fringe Lights the way home for anyone who is lost


Galaxyping Imagination Deep purple fur speckled with tiny stars Turns doodles into real, floating constellations


Meteorping Surprise Orange-red with rocky star clips Drops unexpected surprises, good or bad


Glowping Hope Soft yellow that literally glows in the dark Its light grows brighter the more people believe in it


###


Princess Teenieping OC Ideas (Season 6 Style)


#


*Princess Catch! Teenieping* sends Romi and Heartsping after Princess Teeniepings, alongside Royal Teeniepings Graceping, Claireping and Bonnyping. Royal themes are all about elegance and drama.


OC name Theme Look Power idea


Tiaraping Elegance Pink and gold with a jeweled tiara and puff sleeves Makes everyone act like they’re at a royal ball


Crownping Leadership Royal blue with a big gold crown fringe Gives orders nobody can refuse, until it learns to listen


Waltzping Grace Lilac with a ballgown tail and ribbon shoes Makes people waltz instead of walk


Teaping Politeness Mint green with a teacup hat and a lace collar Turns every argument into a polite tea party


Patienceping Waiting Peach with an hourglass charm Slows down time so nobody misses the important moment


###


Stage Teenieping OC Ideas (Season 7 Style)


#


*Jewel Catch! Teenieping* , Season 7, is set around the Emotion Kingdom’s Emotion Festival, the biggest musical celebration of the year. On SAMG’s page, Heartsping works on her singing, rhythm and dancing, Lemonping brings the spotlight and Limeping shows off a hip-hop charm. Music-themed OCs fit right in.


OC name Theme Look Power idea


Encoreping Applause Gold and red with a curtain-tassel tail Makes the crowd cheer for “one more song” forever


Mixping Remixing Neon green with headphones and a turntable belly emblem Remixes any sound, even a sneeze, into a hit song


Rhymeping Wordplay Purple with a mic-shaped tail Makes everyone talk only in rhymes


Drumping Rhythm Red with drumstick hairpins Everyone nearby moves to its beat, whether they want to or not


Pianoping Harmony Black and white keys on its skirt, a music-note fringe Turns clashing voices into perfect harmony


Season 7’s story starts when the Legend Teeniepings set to headline the festival suddenly disappear, so a Stage Teenieping OC who knows where they went is a ready-made plot hook.


© SAMG


###


Sea Teenieping OC Ideas (Movie Style)


#


The 2026 movie *Teenieping: Legend of the Whale Heartstone* takes Romi and Heartsping under the sea with Kite, a boy from the sea, and Teeniepings like Bubbleping. Ocean OCs are a fresh, less-used theme.


OC name Theme Look Power idea


Coralping Belonging Coral pink with branching coral pigtails Grows a safe home for anyone who feels left out


Tideping Mood swings Blue gradient that shifts like waves Its mood goes in and out like the tide, and so does everyone’s around it


Starfishping Healing Orange with a starfish-shaped fringe Regrows anything that’s broken, like a friendship


Lagoonping Calm Turquoise with a lily-pad hat Makes still, peaceful water wherever it floats


Seashellping Memories Cream and pink with a shell that hums Its shell replays a happy memory when you hold it to your ear


##


Teenieping OC Name Ideas: How to Make Your Own


#


Want a name that isn’t on this list? Use these rules, which match how official English Teenieping names work:


1. **Start with one short word** for the theme: a feeling (Hug, Blush), a food (Mochi, Tart), a gem (Opal, Topaz) or a hobby (Drum, Rhyme).
2. **Add “-ping”** to the end, like Heartsping, Lemonping or Trustping.
3. **Say it out loud.** Two or three syllables sound the most like the show.
4. **Check it isn’t taken.** The show has a lot of Teeniepings. Search the name on the fan wiki or in our[Teenieping characters list](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/teenieping-characters) so your OC doesn’t share a name with a canon one.
5. **Match the name to the power.** If someone can guess what your OC does just from its name, you nailed it.


More quick name starters: Wink, Doodle, Cuddle, Sprinkle, Velvet, Rainbow, Sunny, Cocoa, Breeze, Petal, Echo, Snooze and Glitter. Just add “-ping” and check the wiki.


##


Personality Ideas That Feel Like the Show


#


Official Teeniepings are cute, but they’re rarely perfect. SAMG describes Trustping as a loyal newbie whose one-sided faith “often leads to lousy incidents,” and Trueping as “sometimes too honest” in a way that “creates uncomfortable situations.” Give your OC a strength that can also cause trouble:


- **Too helpful:** it fixes problems nobody asked it to fix.
- **Too honest:** it can’t keep a surprise party secret.
- **Too brave:** it charges in first and thinks later.
- **Too shy:** its power only works when nobody is looking.
- **Too competitive:** it turns everything into a contest, even naps.


That one flaw is what turns a cute design into a character people want to write stories about.


##


Teenieping OC x Canon Story Prompts


#


OC x canon means putting your original character into a story with the official cast. Here are prompts built on real details from the show:


- **Your OC x Romi:** Romi catches your OC, but it begs to stay free for one more day to help a lonely kid in Harmony Town. Does she let it?
- **Your OC x Heartsping:** Your OC wants to become a Royal Teenieping and asks Heartsping, the Teenieping of Love, to train it.
- **Your OC x the Season 7 team:** Your Stage Teenieping OC is the only one who saw the Legend Teeniepings vanish before the Emotion Festival. Lemonping wants the spotlight, Cherryping wants a plan and Limeping just wants to dance. Who listens first?
- **Your OC x Heartrose Bakery:** A Dessert Teenieping OC hides inside Sarah’s Heartrose Bakery and keeps “improving” the recipes. Ian, Kyle and Jun are confused.
- **Your OC x Maya and Marylou:** Your OC accidentally gives sporty, competitive Marylou its power for a day.
- **Your OC in the Whale Heartstone sea:** Your Sea Teenieping OC guides Romi, Heartsping and Kite through the underwater city.


© SAMG


Need help keeping canon details straight? Check[where to watch Catch! Teenieping](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/where-to-watch-catch-teenieping) to rewatch the episodes your story is based on.


##


Turn Your OC Idea Into a Design


#


Once you’ve picked an idea, sketch it on the basic Teenieping shape: a big round head, huge low-set eyes, a small rounded body, short limbs and a symbol on the belly. Our[how to draw Teenieping guide](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/how-to-draw-teenieping) walks you through the base shape and the eyes step by step, so you can use it as your own Teenieping OC base. Then add your OC’s color palette and signature accessory, and you’re done.


For a full walkthrough of building, naming and playing a Teenieping OC, see our[Catch! Teenieping OC maker guide](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/catch-teenieping-oc-maker) .

##


FAQ


#


###


How do you make a Teenieping OC?


#


Pick one feeling or theme, turn it into a name ending in “-ping,” choose a color palette and one signature accessory, and decide what its magic does to people. Then draw it on the basic Teenieping shape: big head, big low-set eyes, small body and a belly symbol.


###


What are some good Teenieping OC name ideas?


#


Add “-ping” to a short theme word, like Blushping, Hugping, Opalping, Mochiping, Cometping or Encoreping. Check the fan wiki first so your name is not already used by a canon Teenieping.


###


What theme should my Teenieping OC have?


#


Choose one emotion or idea, just like the official Teeniepings. You can also match a season: gems for Jewel Teeniepings, keys and secrets for Key Teeniepings, sweets for Dessert Teeniepings, space for Star Teeniepings, royalty for Princess Teeniepings or music for Season 7 Stage Teeniepings.


###


What does OC x canon mean for Teenieping?


#


It means writing or drawing your original character together with official characters, such as Romi, Heartsping or the Season 7 Royal Teeniepings Lemonping, Cherryping and Limeping.


###


Can I play as my Teenieping OC?


#


Yes. In Redbean you can describe your OC or upload a sketch to turn it into a pixel character that talks, remembers and makes friends in a town you build. It is a fan-made creation, not an official Catch! Teenieping game.
